blocks.text: Reading County Data: Charts and Tables
The two figures below summarize the county data used in Lab 5. Read each caption first, then look at the axes before you read the values.
Land cover by type (percent of county area)
Figure 1. Land cover in the county. Forest covers 42 percent of the area; grassland and cropland together cover 45 percent.
Forest and grassland together account for more than two thirds of the county. Urban land is the smallest category at five percent.
Carbon dioxide at the monitoring station (ppm)
Figure 2. Carbon dioxide concentration at the county monitoring station, 2000 to 2025, in parts per million.
Table 1. Land cover and area Type Percent Area (square km) Forest 42 1,050 Grassland 27 675 Cropland 18 450 Wetland 8 200 Urban 5 125
Question 1. Using Figure 2, estimate the change in carbon dioxide between 2000 and 2025 and express it as a percentage of the 2000 value.
Question 2. Which land cover types could be converted into one another by human activity within a decade? Explain.
